Title: Datadog – An Azure Native ISV Service – the most desired new features now available

Body.Content:
The most desired Datadog – An Azure Native ISV Service capabilities are now available.

  • Multi-Subscription Monitoring – Easily manage monitoring of all your Azure subscriptions with Datadog from one place for a single pane-of-glass view.
  • Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) – A new integrated setting to enable users to send information about their Azure resources to the Datadog CSPM product and track conformance to industry benchmarks such as Center for Internet Security (CIS).
  • Mute Monitor for expected VM shutdowns – Reduce distractions during expected VM shutdowns by muting the monitor for such events.

Learn more on Azure Blog 

Get it now on Azure Marketplace
